en.headline: Hong Kong PMI slips to 49.5 in August after three-month rise
en.dek: The S&P Global Hong Kong SAR PMI fell below the 50 mark, pointing to a renewed contraction in private-sector conditions after July's reading of 51.0.
body: The S&P Global Hong Kong SAR Purchasing Managers' Index fell to 49.5 in August from 51.0 in July, signalling a renewed deterioration in private-sector business conditions after three consecutive months of expansion, according to the survey compiled by the data provider.

Output and new orders both contracted for the first time since April, as higher prices and weaker domestic and global demand weighed on activity and sales. New export business also declined marginally, although demand from the mainland edged higher.

Input-cost inflation accelerated to a three-month high, driven by higher raw-material and staff costs, and firms raised selling prices at the fastest pace since April 2023. Employment declined for a fifth consecutive month as weaker demand and spare capacity discouraged hiring.

Business confidence weakened further. Firms were more pessimistic about the year-ahead outlook, citing concerns over the domestic economy, US tariffs and geopolitical uncertainty. A reading above 50 indicates expansion; a reading below 50 indicates contraction.

zh.headline: 8月香港PMI回落至49.5 連升三個月後再收縮
zh.dek: 標普全球香港特區採購經理指數由7月的51.0跌至49.5，顯示私營部門營商環境在連續三個月擴張後再度轉差。
body: 標普全球公布，香港特區採購經理指數（PMI）由7月的51.0回落至8月的49.5，顯示私營部門營商環境在連續三個月擴張後再度轉差。
產出及新訂單自4月以來首次同步收縮，較高價格以及本地和全球需求轉弱拖累活動及銷售。新出口業務亦輕微下跌，不過來自內地的需求則略為上升。
投入成本通脹加快至三個月高位，原材料及員工成本上升，企業上調售價的速度為2023年4月以來最快。就業連續第五個月下跌，需求轉弱及閒置產能令企業減少招聘。
企業對未來一年的展望更趨悲觀，擔心本地經濟、美國關稅及地緣政治不明朗因素。指數高於50代表擴張，低於50則代表收縮。
